title: 第3章  动我妹妹，你们找死！
content_zh:
方家议事大厅内，气氛冷冽如冰，令人生寒。
众人望向方玄的眼神，满是惊愕与不敢置信。
谁能料到，本以为已经陨落的方玄，竟活生生地站在了这里，还一掌击毙了造血境四重的方志。
他的痴症痊愈了？而且还恢复了修为？
这怎么可能！
“放肆！”
一声冷喝如惊雷般炸响，瞬间打破了这短暂的寂静。
方岳指着方玄，厉声呵斥：“方玄，你竟敢残害同族，简直罪大恶极！依照族规，当剥夺你的血脉，即刻处死！”
无论方玄是否恢复神智，也不管他是否真的恢复了修为，在方岳心中，此人绝不能留！
“二叔，不要！”
方柔艰难地挣扎着，“扑通”一声跪在地上，声泪俱下地哀求：“二叔，各位长老，还望看在我哥曾经为家族而战的份上，放了他这一次吧，一切都是我的错，要罚就罚我吧。”
“小妹，起来，无需向这群人下跪！”
方玄疾步上前，一把扶起方柔。看着他满身伤痕，方玄心中刺痛，“小妹，哥哥让你受苦了。”
方柔凝视着眼前的少年，愣了许久，泪水夺眶而出，嘴唇颤抖着问道：“哥……真的是你吗？”
她害怕这是一场梦。
“是我。”
方玄轻声回应，扶着方柔坐下，一股温和的混沌之力悄然渡入方柔体内，缓缓缓解她的伤势。
而方柔身上的伤势，也让方玄眼中寒芒更胜。
方玄缓缓回头，目光如冰刀般射向方岳，嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度。
“残害同族？罪大恶极？”

方玄目光如剑般射向方岳，环视众人，一字一顿道：“方柔是我方玄的妹妹。”
“不管是谁，谁敢动她......”
方玄眼中，杀机四溢。
“杀无赦！”
少年的话语掷地有声，仿若洪钟，在大厅内回荡。
不少人眼神躲闪，不敢与方玄对视。
他们曾经，可没少欺负方玄。
“方玄，你太放肆了！”
方岳大怒，冷喝道：“此乃家族重地，岂容你在此口出狂言？目无尊长的东西。方松方涛，给我把他们这对兄妹押进水牢，等候处置！”
立刻，两道身影宛如猎豹般扑向方玄，周身气血翻滚。
正是方松和方涛。
一人造血境五重，一人造血境六重，都比方志要强。
两人一直是方霄的狗腿子，在方玄痴傻的三年里没少欺负他。
若是三年前，方玄顾念血脉亲情，最多只是略施惩戒。
然而这三年来，他痴傻受尽屈辱折磨，如今这些人又欺辱小妹，羞辱父亲母亲，他怎会再心慈手软，定要以雷霆手段，彻底镇杀！
念及至此，方玄眼中寒芒大盛，悍然出手。
“啪啪——”
方玄的速度太快了，方松两人只觉得眼前一花，身体就以来时更快的速度倒飞出去，重重砸在地上，吐血不止。
方玄活动手腕，面无表情：“三年前你们是废物，现在还是如此废物！”
“嘶——”

看着重伤垂死的两人，众人倒吸一口凉气，瞪大眼睛，满脸难以置信地看着方玄。
这个曾经的傻子，不仅恢复了神智，似乎还恢复了修为，而且手段比三年前更加狠辣凌厉。
他这三天，到底经历了什么？
“还有谁不怕死的，尽管上来。”
方玄满含杀意的目光扫过一众方家人，语气森然。
“小畜生，你太狂妄了！”
方岳周身气息汹涌涌动，眼中寒芒爆射：“以为仗着些旁门左道，就能在此为所欲为？今日，我便要清理门户，将你这小畜生当场击毙！”
“方岳，你敢！”
就在方岳正要出手之时，二长老方山河疾步上前，挡在方玄身前，直视方岳。
三长老也顺势开口：“方岳，你如此迫不及待出手，是想不教而诛吗？”
“二长老，此子残害同族，心肠歹毒，手段狠辣，这样的人，必须就地诛杀，才能维护我方家威严！”
方岳声色俱厉：“否则此事传扬出去，我方家颜面何存？威严何在？”
“简直荒谬！”
方山河毫不客气地反驳：“方志等人以前是如何欺辱玄儿的？你们难道不清楚？冒犯少主本就是重罪，他们落得如此下场，完全是咎由自取，怨不得旁人！”
“你......”
方岳待要开口，却被方霄拦了下来：“父亲莫急。你要是真杀了这个废物，岂不是让人说你以大欺小，落人口舌？”
“霄儿，你打算怎么做？”
方岳看向方霄，有些不解。
“我方家祖训，少主之位，能者居之。”
方霄双手负后，神情傲然：“十日后，恰好是我方家族比，那我就与方玄比试一场，谁赢，谁就是方家少主。”

方岳闻言，双眸一亮。
他知道，儿子方霄，这是要踩着方玄扬名，坐实他的天才之名，稳坐少主之位。
反正方玄一介废物，又岂是霄儿对手。
届时堂堂正正的将之击杀，谁敢说半点不是？
方霄看向方玄，冷冷开口：“方玄，十日后，生死一战，你可敢接？”
生死战？
众人闻言，皆是一惊。
这方霄，看来是必杀方玄啊。
“杀你，何须......”
不等方玄把话说完，一道清脆的声音蓦地响起。
“简直胡闹！”
只见一名女子快步走来，即便满身风尘，也掩盖不住她一身清冷气韵。
“雨容，你怎么回来了？”
见到来人，大长老面露惊喜。
方雨容是他收养的孙女，自幼天赋卓绝，不输方玄方霄，更是拜入了问道宗。
若非不是方家血脉，这方家少主，本该是她。
“我再不回来，方家就要闹翻天了。”
方雨容美眸含星，依次扫过众人，视线落在方玄身上的时候，眼底微微一亮，但也只是略作停留，最后看向方霄。
“同族血脉，岂能喊打喊杀？传出去，很好听吗？”
方雨容贵为问道宗弟子，身份远超寻常方家族人，甚至长老，她一开口，众人尽皆沉默。

“雨容侄女，你这话有失偏颇了。”
方岳冷哼道：“是方玄这小畜生出手在先，杀了方志，重伤方松方涛；霄儿也只是按照规矩约战罢了。”
闻言，方雨容这才注意到，方志的尸体和重伤的方松两人，看向方玄的眼神，带着一抹诧异。
“哼！”
哪知，方雨容只是冷哼一声，说道：“方玄本是方家少主，他们以下犯上，咎由自取。”
方岳怒道：“方雨容，你这是偏袒方玄；少主之争，岂容你一个外人插嘴！”
“你......”
这话，气得方雨容面色涨红，却无话可说。
“雨容，休得胡闹。”
这时，大长老漠然开口：“此事，由方玄方霄自行定夺。”
方雨容并非方家血脉，这一点连他都不好说什么。
“爷爷......”
方雨容就要开口，就被少年打断。
“这生死战，我接了！”
方雨容扭头，瞪大美眸看着方玄，恼怒道：“你疯了？还是痴症又犯了？”
“我有分寸。”
方玄看向方霄，面无表情的说道：“他要战，那便战。我会堂堂正正杀了你，将属于我的东西，拿回来！”
“好！”
方霄狞然一笑，说道：“既然如此，那就签订生死契约，十日之后，分高下，定生死！”
很快，双方签订契约，方雨容见状，气得跺脚转身就走。

“方玄，珍惜最后的时光吧。”
方霄收好生死契约，满脸讥讽的看着方玄，冷冷道：“十天之后，方家再无方玄，只知我方霄！”
“这句话同样送给你。”
方玄面无表情道：“十天时间，够你准备棺材了。”
说罢，方玄搀扶着方柔离去。
看向方玄的背影，方霄眼中寒芒迸射。
方岳低声道：“霄儿，有把握吗？”
“父亲放心，此战我必胜。”
方霄紧握五指，掌心有玉芒一闪而逝。
方岳见状，猛然大喜。
......
“嘎吱——”
推开腐朽的院门，方玄目露复杂。
他本是方家少主，本不该住在这破败脏乱的地方，但痴傻三年，被方岳等人，硬生生的搬出主宅，丢在这个紧邻猪圈的地方。
“哥，你先休息一下，我马上打扫一下。”
把方玄按在凳子上坐下，方柔开始清理小院。
这时，院门被人推开，只见方雨容俏脸铁青的站在门口，冷冷的看着方玄。
“雨容姐，你来啦，快坐。”
方柔连忙丢掉手中的活计，朝外走去：“我去给你们拿些吃的。”
等到方柔离去，方玄看着眼前的少女，脸上难得露出一抹笑意。

“雨容姐，你怎么来了？”
方雨容走进小院，犹自瞪着方玄。
“别叫我姐！”
方雨容对着方玄就是一顿劈头盖脸的怒骂：“你可知道，那方霄觉醒了地阶武脉，修为更是已入造血境圆满，随时可以突破到炼体境，你拿什么跟他斗？你这么做，对得起方叔叔吗？”
语气严厉，满是恨铁不成钢。
“我知道。”
方玄语气平缓，却带着一抹强大自信：“若不是雨容姐你突然回来，方霄已经是个死人了。”
方雨容大他三岁。
母亲去世后，方雨容对他们兄妹多有照顾。
只是他后来无法修行，变成痴傻，方雨容与他之间便有些疏离。
但那份情，方玄铭记至今。
“方玄，你别嘴硬了。”
方雨容说道：“我知道你这些年受了很多委屈，但是你不该应战的。这样，你跟我去求爷爷，求方岳他们，取消这次比试。”
说着就要去拉方玄，却被方玄避开。
“不必了。”
闻言，方玄脸色微冷，语气平静却充满不容置疑：“这一战，方霄必须死！”
“你简直无可救药！”
好心被当成驴肝肺，方雨容气得双眼发红，恼羞成怒道：“方玄，你太让我太失望了！”
她本就是听说方玄出事，所以马不停蹄的赶回方家。
见到方玄活着，她无比高兴；但方玄的所作所为，让她太过失望。

目送方雨容离去，方玄心中古井无波。
今日没杀方霄，除了方雨容出现之外，他同样需要在方家族比上，堂堂正正击败方霄，拿回属于自己的一切。
“小贱人，还敢偷东西，老子打死你！”
就在方玄正要修炼之时，冷喝咒骂声响起，还夹杂着方柔痛苦惨叫声。
他猛然冲出小院，只见两名方家人，正对着地上的方柔，拳打脚踢。
方玄眼中寒芒暴涨，杀意席卷。
“你们，找死！”
content_en:
The atmosphere in the Fang family's meeting hall was as cold as ice, making people feel chilly.
Everyone looked at Fang Xuan with eyes full of shock and disbelief.
Who could have expected that Fang Xuan, who was thought to have died, would actually be standing here alive and kill Fang Zhi, who was at the fourth level of the blood-producing realm, with one palm.
Is he cured of his dementia? And he also recovered his cultivation?
How is this possible!
"Presumptuous!"
A cold shout sounded like thunder, instantly breaking the brief silence.
Fang Yue pointed at Fang Xuan and scolded sternly: "Fang Xuan, you dare to harm your own clan. This is a heinous crime! According to the clan rules, you will be deprived of your bloodline and executed immediately!"
No matter whether Fang Xuan regains his sanity or not, and no matter whether he really recovers his cultivation level, in Fang Yue's heart, this person must not be allowed to stay!
"Second uncle, no!"
Fang Rou struggled hard and knelt on the ground with a plop, begging with tears in her eyes: "Second uncle, elders, I hope that for the sake of my brother's fighting for the family, please let him go this time. Everything is my fault. If you want to punish me, then punish me."
"Little sister, get up, there is no need to kneel to these people!"
Fang Xuan stepped forward quickly and helped Fang Rou up. Seeing the scars all over his body, Fang Xuan's heart hurt, "Little sister, my brother has made you suffer."
Fang Rou stared at the young man in front of her and was stunned for a long time. Tears welled up in her eyes. Her lips trembled and she asked: "Brother... is it really you?"
She was afraid it was a dream.
"It's me."
Fang Xuan responded softly and helped Fang Rou sit down. A gentle force of chaos quietly entered Fang Rou's body, slowly relieving her injuries.
The injuries on Fang Rou's body also made Fang Xuan's eyes even colder.
Fang Xuan slowly turned around, his eyes shot towards Fang Yue like ice knives, and the corners of his mouth curled up with a cold arc.
"Murturing a fellow kinsman? Is it a heinous crime?"
Fang Xuan's gaze shot towards Fang Yue like a sword, he looked around at everyone and said word by word: "Fang Rou is my sister Fang Xuan."
"No matter who it is, who dares to touch her..."
Fang Xuan's eyes were filled with murderous intent.
"Kill without mercy!"
The young man's words were loud and resonant like a bell, echoing in the hall.
Many people dodge their eyes, not daring to look at Fang Xuan.
They used to bully Fang Xuan a lot.
"Fang Xuan, you are too presumptuous!"
Fang Yue was furious and shouted coldly: "This is the important place of the family, how can I allow you to speak arrogantly here? You have no respect for your superiors. Fang Song and Fang Tao, take these brothers and sisters to the water prison for me to wait for disposal!"
Immediately, two figures pounced on Fang Xuan like cheetahs, energy and blood rolling around their bodies.
It was Fang Song and Fang Tao.
One person is at the fifth level of the blood realm, and the other is at the sixth level of the blood realm, both of which are stronger than Fang Zhi.
The two of them have always been Fang Xiao's henchmen, and they often bullied Fang Xuan during his stupid three years.
If it were three years ago, Fang Xuan would only give a slight punishment at most if he cared about blood ties.
However, in the past three years, he has been stupidly humiliated and tortured. Now these people have bullied his little sister and humiliated his father and mother. How could he be so merciless again? He must use thunderous means to completely kill them!
Thinking of this, Fang Xuan's eyes grew cold and he took action boldly.
"Papa -"
Fang Xuan's speed was so fast that Fang Song and Fang Song felt their eyes blurred as their bodies flew backwards faster than before, hitting the ground hard and vomiting blood.
Fang Xuan moved his wrists and said expressionlessly: "You were trash three years ago, and you are still such trash now!"
"Hiss——"
Seeing the two people who were seriously injured and dying, everyone took a deep breath, widened their eyes, and looked at Fang Xuan in disbelief.
This former fool not only regained his sanity, but also seemed to have recovered his cultivation, and his methods were even more ruthless than three years ago.
What has he experienced in the past three days?
"If there is anyone who is not afraid of death, just come up."
Fang Xuan glanced at all the Fang family members with murderous eyes and spoke in a solemn tone.
"Little beast, you are so arrogant!"
Fang Yue's aura surged around his body, and a cold light shot out from his eyes: "I thought I could rely on some outsiders toDao, can you do whatever you want here? Today, I will clean up the house and kill you little beast on the spot! "
"Fang Yue, how dare you! "
Just when Fang Yue was about to take action, the second elder Fang Shanhe stepped forward quickly, blocked in front of Fang Xuan, and looked directly at Fang Yue.
The third elder also took the opportunity to speak: "Fang Yue, you are so impatient to take action, do you want to kill him without teaching? "
"Second Elder, this man has killed his fellow clan members with a vicious heart and ruthless methods. Such a person must be killed on the spot in order to maintain the dignity of our family! "
Fang Yue's voice was stern: "Otherwise if this matter spreads, how will our Fang family's face be saved? Where is the majesty? "
"Absolutely ridiculous! "
Fang Shanhe retorted unceremoniously: "How did Fang Zhi and others bully Xuan'er before? Don't you know? Offending the young master is a serious crime. They have ended up like this entirely because of themselves and cannot blame anyone else! "
"You..."
Fang Yue was about to speak, but was stopped by Fang Xiao: "Father, don't be anxious. If you really kill this good-for-nothing, wouldn't it mean that people would say that you bullied the small by bullying them? "
"Xiao'er, what are you going to do? "
Fang Yue looked at Fang Xiao, somewhat puzzled.
"The ancestral motto of our Fang family is that the position of young master should be occupied by those who are capable. "
Fang Xiao put his hands behind his back and looked proud: "Ten days from now, it happens to be our family's competition, so I will compete with Fang Xuan, and whoever wins will be the young master of the Fang family. "
When Fang Yue heard this, his eyes lit up.
He knew that his son Fang Xiao wanted to step on Fang Xuan to become famous, confirm his reputation as a genius, and secure his position as young master.
Anyway, Fang Xuan is a loser, how can he be Xiao'er's opponent.
At that time, he will be killed in a dignified manner. Who dares to say that he is not wrong at all?
Fang Xiao looked at Fang Xuan and said coldly: "Fang Xuan, ten days from now, in a life and death battle, do you dare to accept it? "
A life and death battle?
Everyone was shocked when they heard this.
This Fang Xiao seems to be the one who must kill Fang Xuan.
"Kill you, why..."
Before Fang Xuan could finish speaking, a crisp voice suddenly sounded.
“It’s just nonsense! "
I saw a woman walking quickly. Even though she was covered in dust, her cold aura could not be concealed.
"Yurong, why are you back? "
Seeing the visitor, the great elder looked surprised.
Fang Yurong is his adopted granddaughter. She has been extremely talented since she was a child, not inferior to Fang Xuan and Fang Xiao. She even joined the Taoist Sect.
If not for the blood of the Fang family, the young master of the Fang family should have been her.
“If I don’t come back, the Fang family will be in trouble. "
Fang Yurong's beautiful eyes were full of stars, and she scanned everyone one by one. When her eyes fell on Fang Xuan, her eyes lit up slightly, but she only paused for a moment, and finally looked at Fang Xiao.
“How can we fight and kill people of the same bloodline? Spread it out, does it sound good? "
Fang Yuronggui was a disciple of the Taoist Sect, and her status was much higher than that of ordinary Fang family members, even elders. As soon as she opened her mouth, everyone fell silent.
"Niece Yurong, your words are biased. "
Fang Yue snorted coldly: "It was the little beast Fang Xuan who made the first move, killing Fang Zhi and seriously injuring Fang Song and Fang Tao; Xiao'er just made the fight according to the rules. "
Hearing this, Fang Yurong noticed that Fang Zhi's corpse and the seriously injured Fang Song looked at Fang Xuan with a touch of surprise.
"Hmph! "
Unexpectedly, Fang Yurong just snorted coldly and said: "Fang Xuan is the young master of the Fang family. They will bring the blame upon themselves. "
Fang Yue said angrily: "Fang Yurong, you are favoring Fang Xuan; how can you, an outsider, be allowed to interfere in the young master's dispute! "
"You..."
These words made Fang Yurong's face turn red with anger, but he had nothing to say.
"Yurong, don't mess around. "
At this time, the Great Elder said indifferently: "This matter is decided by Fang Xuan and Fang Xiao. "
Fang Yurong was not of the Fang family, which even he couldn't say anything about.
"Grandpa..."
Fang Yurong was about to speak, but was interrupted by the young man.
"I'll take this life-and-death fight! "
Fang Yurong turned around, looked at Fang Xuan with wide beautiful eyes, and said angrily:"Are you crazy? Or is the madness coming back?"
"I'm measured."
Fang Xuan looked at Fang Xiao and said expressionlessly: "If he wants to fight, then fight. I will kill you openly and get back what belongs to me!"
"Okay!"
Fang Xiao smiled ferociously and said: "In that case, let's sign a life and death contract. After ten days, we will decide the difference between the superior and the inferior!"
Soon, the two parties signed a contract. When Fang Yurong saw this, he stomped his feet and turned around to leave.
"Fang Xuan, cherish your last moments."
Fang Xiao put away the life and death contract, looked at Fang Xuan with a sarcastic face, and said coldly: "In ten days, there will be no Fang Xuan in the Fang family, only me, Fang Xiao!"
"This sentence is also for you."
Fang Xuan said expressionlessly: "Ten days are enough for you to prepare the coffin."
After that, Fang Xuan helped Fang Rou and left.
Looking at Fang Xuan's back, Fang Xiao's eyes flashed with cold light.
Fang Yue whispered: "Xiao'er, are you sure?"
"Father, don't worry, I will win this battle."
Fang Xiao clenched his five fingers, and a jade light flashed in his palm.
When Fang Yue saw this, he was suddenly overjoyed.
...
"Crunch——"
Pushing open the decaying courtyard door, Fang Xuan's eyes were complicated.
He was originally the young master of the Fang family and should not have lived in this dilapidated and dirty place. However, after three years of stupidity, Fang Yue and others forcibly moved him out of the main house and left him in this place next to the pig pen.
"Brother, you take a rest first, I'll clean up right away."
Pressing Fang Xuan on the stool and sitting down, Fang Rou began to clean the small courtyard.
At this time, the courtyard door was pushed open, and Fang Yurong was seen standing at the door with a pretty face ashen, looking at Fang Xuan coldly.
"Sister Yurong, you are here, sit down quickly."
Fang Rou quickly threw away her work and walked out: "I'll get you some food."
After Fang Rou left, Fang Xuan looked at the girl in front of him with a rare smile on his face.
